name: wow-unified-sim
description: Unified WoW simulation & optimization platform: in-game addon -> local bridge -> hybrid sim engine.

scripts.dev: npm run dev --workspace=@usim/server & npm run dev --workspace=@usim/web
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=@usim/simc-profile && npm run build --workspace=@usim/server && npm run build --workspace=@usim/web && npm run build --workspace=@usim/desktop
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace=@usim/simc-profile && npm run typecheck --workspace=@usim/server && npm run typecheck --workspace=@usim/web && npm run typecheck --workspace=@usim/desktop
